video_title: Ja Morant Traded! + Jalen Duren To Lakers?!?

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons evaluates Ja Morant's fit with the Trail Blazers
quotes.excerpt: Ja Morant is extremely talented. All the stuff he's been dragged through, he's got a great opportunity.
quotes.quote: It's a lot of guards. It's a lot of guys that need the ball in their hands usually to succeed, and there's only one basketball on that team. But I like the aggressiveness from Portland. I know they wanted to get off Jerami Grant, and at least Memphis got back players that can play right now, starting-level players with Kris Murray and with Jerami Grant. But I do, I like Ja Morant. We still don't know what version of Damian Lillard we're going to get. I'd like to imagine he's going to play more off-guard. I don't think he's going to handle the ball in the usage rate is going to be too high for 35 minutes, coming off what he's coming off at his age. But Ja Morant is extremely talented. All the stuff he's been dragged through, all the distractions, he's got a great opportunity just to make that an old memory and go out there and hoop because people might forget how good this dude is when he is on the floor and he is healthy and he is rolling.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Lou Williams and Chandler Parsons discuss Ja Morant's fresh start
quotes.excerpt: It's an opportunity for him to get all the way away from Memphis, go somewhere with a fresh fan base.

text_blocks.speaker: Lou Williams
text_blocks.text: It's an opportunity for him to get all the way away from Memphis, go somewhere with a fresh fan base. Go somewhere where they're actually trying to build in the right direction. And look, if they can get over the hump and make some noise, he's going to be part of their story. I agree with Chandler with what he said about the depth. Now, they do have some questions to be answered. They do got some spots to fill at that wing spot. They got to go out and get some size. They got plenty enough guard play if they stay in how they stand.

text_blocks.speaker: Chandler Parsons
text_blocks.text: Maybe Scoot Henderson or Drew Eubanks, one of those guys are going to be on the move to kind of balance some things out and put them in the right direction where they can have two balanced groups to go out there and compete at a high level.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons on Ja Morant's potential for an All-NBA season
quotes.excerpt: When those two dudes are healthy, they are absolute All-NBA type guys.
quotes.quote: I think Ja Morant, he's kind of in that same boat as Trey Young for me this year where he's kind of been disrespected, kind of been thrown around in trade values. His value was all-time low. But when those two dudes are healthy, they are absolute All-NBA type guys and I think they're both poised for huge years. So I'm happy for Ja Morant to get a fresh start.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Lou Williams on the competitive landscape of the Western Conference
quotes.excerpt: So many different storylines going on in that Western Conference. I can't really call it for Portland.
quotes.quote: They were competitive last year and they made some noise. But I would like to see how Ja Morant is going to level up with these guys. He's going to give them a different look. I imagine they're going to play faster. They're going to be a more athletic team, going to run the lanes, be a three-point shooting team, be a team that slashes and just plays hard. But where they level up in the West, that's a tall task to try to figure out at this point with that trade happening. So many different storylines going on in that Western Conference. I can't really call it for Portland.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons analyzes the Blazers' roster construction
quotes.excerpt: When you look at Drew Eubanks, he's more of a defending type setup point guard.
quotes.quote: When you look at Drew Eubanks, he's more of a defending type setup point guard. Ja Morant's more of an explosive athletic transitional point guard. And Damian Lillard is arguably the best shooter in the NBA who you can definitely put him off the ball, have him come off some actions, some pin-downs, some screens, and play him more at the two position now. Defensively, obviously with Ja Morant and Damian Lillard, there's going to be some holes. They almost need Drew Eubanks in that lineup to kind of make up for the defensive slack there. But again, these guys are at the age now where they're going to have to adapt, they're going to have to have a more balanced attack.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons on the Warriors' potential pursuit of LeBron and AD
quotes.excerpt: I think the season tickets go up, I think the jersey sales are unbelievable.
quotes.quote: I think the season tickets go up, I think the jersey sales are unbelievable. I think it's so much fun to see all those legends on the court at the same time. But this move doesn't make the Thunder worse, this move doesn't make the Spurs worse. Like the Nuggets, the Timberwolves, the Rockets, like the Lakers, there's still so many teams that are so competitive in the Western Conference that I'd like to see it. It's fun, I think that'd be a hell of a way for LeBron James to go out with his boys. We know how close he is with Anthony Davis, we know how close he is with Draymond Green. We know how much he respects the Warriors organization and Stephen Curry. So could this be fun? Yeah, and I'll tell you this, the fact that Draymond Green opted out of a $28 million deal, like his part is done. You don't just see a player like that opt out without knowing what's coming back on a longer-term deal.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Lou Williams on the historical failure of superteams
quotes.excerpt: History tells me when all the legends in the Hall of Fame guys link up, it never works.
quotes.quote: As much as I want to love this, I don't know. Just history tells me when all the legends in the Hall of Fame guys link up at the end of the road, it never works out. I've just seen this movie time and time and time again. I've seen Russell Westbrook, Carmelo Anthony, so on and so forth. All of our legends go link up with the other legends at the end of their careers for a feel-good story, and it just never ends well. I don't want this to be a damper on Stephen Curry, I don't want this to be a damper on LeBron James, Anthony Davis, or Draymond. I just feel like everybody go to your respective corners, and let's finish this thing out smoothly instead of all linking up and leaving a bad taste in people's mouths after that experience.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons on the financial implications of superteams
quotes.excerpt: All of these guys are still worth a lot of money. So how are you going to fill the roster?
quotes.quote: And listen, all of these guys are still worth a lot of money. So how are you going to fill the rest of this roster? Where is the other talent going to come from? All of these guys want a shitload of money still. So we got to figure that part out. And it looks like it's going to be a lot of vets. We're going to see cats miss games with arthritis on this roster.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons on the Pistons' roster management of Jalen Duren
quotes.excerpt: It's very weird to me if the Pistons don't match Jalen Duren considering they also just traded Isaiah Stewart.
quotes.quote: It's very weird to me if the Pistons don't match Jalen Duren considering they also just traded Isaiah Stewart to the Grizzlies and now they would be losing both their bigs. It's very interesting. It's no secret that Jalen Duren, he played really, really bad in the postseason. He kind of played himself out of that max contract, but all he needs is one offer and all he needs is one team to come in there and give him 40 plus million a year, and that perfect suitor is usually the Sacramento Kings who are desperate to get off this contract, who at least they get young, at least they get a guy like a franchise piece to put with a cuff.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Lou Williams on the Pistons' leverage in Jalen Duren's contract
quotes.excerpt: They're just making them go out and say, 'Look, if you think you're worth this, show us.'
quotes.quote: Yeah, that's the logical thing that they do. They're just making them go out and say, 'Look, if you think you're worth this, show us a couple teams that feel the same way and we'll match the deal.' That's what it looks like to me. I don't think he's on the move. Yeah, that's the logical thing that they do. They're just making them go out and say, 'Look, if you think you're worth this, show us a couple teams that feel the same way and we'll match the deal.'
